race.comment: FLAMBOYANT LAD (7) can continue the momentum after winning a BM66 at Quirindi as a well-supported favourite, beating Zou Big Boy by half a length, and the sharp weight drop offsets some of the rise in grade. Respect. GREEN RUN (3) comes through a BM78 at Newcastle and a Quality at Randwick, both at big odds, so recent form is not glowing. This easier race and quick back-up with the good 1600m record give him a better platform for a placing push. TAINUI (5) is harder to trust on recent figures after two plain Open runs, including a ninth behind GREEN RUN at Coonamble, but the drop back to BM82 and Kody Nestor's strong record on him keep him in the mix. Goes well here. TAIPAN LEGEND (4) kept fresh following a below par seventh in Open company at Newcastle over 1350m. Kept up to the mark with a 1100m trial and has an imposing record over this course and distance.
